thread.title: Apple Music, Coming To A Coffee Shop Near You

author: CoffeeBUZZ
title: Apple Music, Coming To A Coffee Shop Near You
text:
Posted on December 6, 2018
Amid Apple ‘s (NASDAQ:AAPL) ongoing services push, every opportunity for incremental growth is worth pursuing. Apple Music is among the most important pillars of the company’s services strategy, and the Mac maker now has 56 million subscribers (including free trials), according to a recent report from the Financial Times . But those are all consumers using the service for personal use.
